consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: energy isolation failure on P-3223

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3223, M-3223 and PT-3223 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-3223, M-3223 and PT-3223 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on P-3223, M-3223 and PT-3223 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. P-3223 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 4 December 2018 an incident occurred on P-3223, M-3223 and PT-3223 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
